final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT e.ordersmark AS om, o.timespan AS ts, AVG(e.fillcount) AS af FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.timespan), s2 AS (SELECT ts AS ts2, AVG(af) AS aa FROM s1 GROUP BY ts), s3 AS (SELECT s1.om AS om, s1.ts AS ts, s1.af AS af, s1.af - s2.aa AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.ts = s2.ts2 WHERE s1.af > s2.aa), s4 AS (SELECT om, ts, af, diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ts ORDER BY af DESC) AS rk FROM s3) SELECT om, ts, af, diff, rk FROM s4 WHERE rk <= 3
